intro: Biggest rank disagreements between the SEI board and SP+, 2026 season: from the SP+ top 15 and from our own top 15.

teams.explanation: Memphis's early-down pass PPA (z +2.75) is one of the most extreme single-metric numbers SEI tracks, and the defense makes situations matter: +2.29 on 3rd-down pass PPA allowed, +1.81 on 3rd-down rush. That is why SEI's defense is #38 while SP+'s play-by-play expected scoring says #70. The scoreboard leans SP+'s way — 38 points at Boise State, 41 at South Florida, 34 against East Carolina. SP+ won't bank the takeaways that prop up that defensive half (INT +1.44, fumble +1.39).
hints: Defense drives the gap: SEI off #11 vs def #38.
Strongest metrics: Early pass PPA +2.75, 3rd pass PPA +2.29, 3rd rush PPA +1.81.

teams.explanation: Both boards rank Miami's offense #1 — 3rd-down pass PPA z +2.49, points per drive +2.48, explosiveness +2.01. The whole disagreement is the defense: SEI #49, SP+ #25. Miami gave up 35 twice (Florida State, North Carolina) and 31 in its only loss at Notre Dame, with defensive Havoc at z -1.24 and Stuff at -1.32 behind that. SP+ banks the results of a 9-1 team with a +173 margin; SEI prices the half that allowed those 35s — seven ranks apart, describing the same team.
hints: Defense drives the gap: SEI off #1 vs def #49.
Strongest metrics: 3rd pass PPA +2.49, Pts/drive +2.48, Exp +2.01.

teams.explanation: SP+ has Tech's offense at #8; SEI says #42, and the process file shows why — nothing on that side of the ball clears z +1.24 (early-down rush PPA). The output is loud — 53 on West Virginia, 52 at Oklahoma State — but the efficiency is quiet. The defense is the mirror image: SEI's #23 rides INT creation at z +2.07, where SP+ sits at #37. The 24-37 loss at Cincinnati is the only game either board can't explain on its own terms.

LSU owns some of the best process numbers in the country: defensive Havoc z +2.92, sack rate +2.46, 3rd-down pass PPA +2.77, red-zone TD rate +2.19. SEI built #2 on that. SP+'s expected scoring lands at #9 because the margin (+125, #13) says the same line bends late: one-point losses at Kentucky (34-35) and to Texas (21-22), plus 13-31 at Alabama. The 6-4 record IS the disagreement — SEI treats line violence as durable, SP+ treats those two one-score endings as evidence.
hints: Process outran scoreboard: margin rank #13 (margin +125) but SEI #2.
Strongest metrics: Havoc +2.92, 3rd pass PPA +2.77, Sack% +2.46.

teams.explanation: Nebraska's defense is the agreed part — #11 on both boards, 3rd-down pass PPA allowed z +1.84 — so the +7 gap is offense: SEI #31, SP+ #45. SEI credits 3rd-down pass PPA +1.80 and red-zone TD rate +1.70; SP+ credits four straight losses averaging six points (17-20 Indiana, 14-17 at Oregon, 10-17 Washington, 13-24 at Illinois) and a penalty rate at z -2.40. A +127 margin at 6-4 is an unresolved argument: SEI says the scoreboard lags, SP+ says the offense can't close.
hints: Offense drives the gap: SEI off #31 vs def #11.
Strongest metrics: 3rd pass PPA +1.84, 3rd pass PPA +1.80, RZ TD% +1.70.

teams.explanation: Tennessee's defense is loaded on both sheets: sack rate z +2.19, opponent points per drive +1.80, fumble-forcing +1.62 — SEI's #5, SP+'s #10. The offense splits them: SEI #58, SP+ #22, anchored by 3rd-down pass PPA at z -1.58. The wins say it — 24-14 over Auburn, 24-17 at Arkansas, 22-7 at Texas A&M — the passing game never buys easy looks. SP+ prices what the defense delivers; SEI subtracts what the pass can't do on third down, four ranks apart, same sentence read twice.
hints: Offense drives the gap: SEI off #58 vs def #5.

teams.explanation: Utah is 10-0, but three wins came by one score — 27-24 at Colorado, 28-20 over BYU, 40-39 at Arizona — and SP+'s +21.7 forgives that where SEI's +1.37 does not. The run game is the tell: z -2.33 for runs stuffed behind the line of scrimmage, rescued by 3rd-down rush PPA at +1.97. The defense survives on INT creation (+1.97) without Havoc (-1.35). Both boards know the record outspends the process; they just disagree by three ranks about how much.
hints: Strongest metrics: 3rd rush PPA +1.97, INT% +1.97, 3rd pass PPA +1.59.
